title: Blue Hour and Interior
author: Marguerite Voss
blurb: Mirabel Okafor, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
